authorizer: Install (or clear) an authorizer callback invoked while SQL is compiled.
backup: Back up SOURCE-DB (default main) into the database file FILENAME.
bind_fallback: Callback invoked for $variables in SQL that are not Tcl variables.
busy: Register a busy handler called when the database is locked.
changes: Number of rows changed by the most recent INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.
close: Close the database and delete the DB command.
collate: Define a collating sequence implemented by a Tcl script.
collation_needed: Script invoked when an unknown collation is required.
commit_hook: Script run before each commit; a non-zero result turns the commit into a rollback.
complete: Return 1 if SQL is a complete statement (ends with a semicolon).
config: Query or set a database connection option.
copy: Import rows from a text file into TABLE.
enable_load_extension: Allow or forbid loading SQLite extensions.
errorcode: Numeric error code of the most recent failed call.
erroroffset: Byte offset of the SQL error in the most recent failed statement.
eval: Run SQL. With a SCRIPT, run it once per result row with column values in variables (or ARRAY-NAME elements). Without a script, return all values as a list.
exists: Return 1 if SQL returns at least one row.
format: Run SQL and return the result in a formatted text layout.
function: DB function NAME ?-argcount N? ?-deterministic? ?-directonly? ?-returntype TYPE? SCRIPT
Create an SQL function implemented by a Tcl script.
incrblob: Open a BLOB for incremental I/O and return a channel.
interrupt: Abort the SQL operation currently running.
last_insert_rowid: Rowid of the most recent successful INSERT.
nullvalue: String that represents SQL NULL in results (default empty).
onecolumn: Run SQL and return the first column of the first row.
preupdate: Access old/new row values inside a preupdate hook.
profile: Script run after each statement with its text and elapsed time.
progress: Invoke SCRIPT every N virtual-machine instructions.
rekey: Change the encryption key (encryption builds only).
restore: Replace TARGET-DB (default main) with the contents of FILENAME.
rollback_hook: Script run whenever a transaction is rolled back.
serialize: Return the database as a binary image.
status: Statement counters of the most recent statement.
timeout: How long to wait for a locked database before failing.
total_changes: Total rows changed since the connection was opened.
trace: Script run with the text of each SQL statement before it executes.
trace_v2: Extended tracing; MASK is a list of statement, profile, row, close.
transaction: Run SCRIPT inside BEGIN ... COMMIT; an error (or return code error) rolls back.
unlock_notify: Script run when a blocking lock is released.
update_hook: Script run after each row insert/update/delete: operation, db, table, rowid.
wal_hook: Script run after each commit in WAL mode.
